cohort: 533 term pregnant women delivered by cesarean section
finding: Regional anesthesia resulted in lower blood pressure and heart rate, higher pulse oximetry levels, and fewer side effects compared to general anesthesia in women undergoing cesarean section.
mod_finding: Regional anesthesia resulted in lower blood pressure and heart rate, higher pulse oximetry levels, and fewer side effects compared to general anesthesia in women undergoing cesarean section.
